channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 14 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 14 #VISPRSD
Issued at 05:22 PM 30 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Samar(Motiong, Villareal, Talalora, Hinabangan, SanSebastian), #Leyte(Leyte, Isabel), #Cebu(CityOfNaga and Pinamungajan) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Antique(SanRemigio), #Iloilo(Igbaras, Tubungan, Leon), #Samar(SantaRita, Basey, Pinabacdao, CalbayogCity, SantaMargarita, Gandara, Matuguinao, Paranas, Calbiga), #Leyte(Capoocan, Carigara, Palompon, Merida), #Cebu(SanFernando and ToledoCity) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
